title: Lyttelton township and port
notes: Every building in the township and port not modelled in london.json is typed by rule (tools/building_typology.py) and measured from LINZ 1 m LiDAR: roofs, heights, facade registration and ground levels are measured; facade layouts and wall colours are typical for the type, not observed. Add an entry to buildings[] (as in london.json) to replace a building's typical facade with observed notes.
